reasons.phone: Still a party guest at phone size, but the gele now reads as a round patterned mass, close to a printed afro; the old fan read in one look. (was 5)
reasons.silhouette: Front and back are a round scalloped ball instead of a fan; in both sides the gele is a thin upright fin over a round cap. The outline no longer says gele from every side. (was 5)
reasons.proportion: 1.91 m to the top of the gele, body in range; the wrapper is still a straight tube.
reasons.palette: Indigo with gold and orange rings reads strongly on sand; the print runs round the head mass.
reasons.wear: Gele, matching buba and wrapper, gold shoes; no bag or jewellery, unchanged.
reasons.variety: Still plainly her own: no one else has headwear on this scale.
reasons.budget: Read from the register row: triangles 2,208 of 3,000, drawCalls 2 of 3, materials 2 of 2, bytes 42,232 of 150,000; inside every figure, over 80% on materials.

notes: Scored against the old version side by side (assets:rework-never-scores-lower): the new renders and renders/before, criterion by criterion against the earlier sheet in against. Every face now has white eyes with dark pupils and a red mouth: the faces read on the darkest skins, but at phone size the eyes are two pale specks with a fixed stare; no criterion scores the face.
